R44BB-SURPLUS.head: 2494ac4a140cb2dc18885a2660225b5f89b3b7dc
R44BB-SURPLUS.meaning: For every fixed constant surplus s>=1, width<=3 CNF admits an exact polynomial one-step variable-elimination transition; polynomial exponent depends on s.

R44BB-AUTOMORPH.head: d12a57d0af632815f8d8ec668921a52a785e6ea1
R44BB-AUTOMORPH.meaning: For fixed occurrence degree, a signed formula automorphism fixing a variable identity while reversing its polarity yields an exact safe assignment and is polynomially detectable by bounded-degree graph isomorphism.

R44BC-MAXDEF.head: e294fda96e9b0cb6668791f47a6e51b5013139ce
R44BC-MAXDEF.meaning: Use Szeider's O(2^k n^3) exact SAT algorithm when maximum deficiency k<=floor(log2 N), giving a uniform O(N^4) exact terminal with SAT witness or UNSAT regular-resolution certificate.

anti_drift_rejoin.SZEIDER_FPT_STRUCTURE: Polynomial reduction reaches a delta*-critical formula; assigning any variable either way then decreases maximum deficiency, and the 2^k factor is the binary branch tree.
anti_drift_rejoin.TRUMP_MAPPING: This is the same structural bottleneck as R44AP branchwise max-deficiency descent plus the unresolved exact OR-merge/safe-choice problem.
